paper_title: Weak nuclear decays deep-underground as a probe of axion dark matter
notes: Headline observed limit: recast of the Gran Sasso 40K electron-capture decay-rate modulation data (Bellotti et al.), Fig. 3 yellow region '40-K EC-decay'. Modulation amplitude I = |dGamma/dtheta^2 / Gamma| * rho_DM/(m_a f_a)^2 with |dGamma/dtheta^2/Gamma| = 18.8 (Eq. 4.13) and amplitude limit 6.8e-6 at 2 sigma for oscillation periods 6 h - 800 d (signal frequency 2 m_a, so m_a = pi*hbar/P). Gives 1/f_a = 3.23e8 GeV^-1 x (m_a/eV), a slope-1 line from 3.0e-23 to 9.6e-20 eV; reproduces the quoted excluded range f_a < 1.0e14 - 3.2e10 GeV and matches the vector-figure wedge coordinates. The weaker 137Cs beta-decay limit (amplitude 9.6e-5, |ratio| 2.13, masses 6.6e-23 - 9.6e-20 eV) is entirely contained in the 40K wedge and not reported. Paper assumes rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (canonical, no rescale). The future 40K measurement up to 1e-9 eV is a projection and excluded here.
